lines.text: New jacket, new shoes, new confidence!
Nice jacket, you've got drip today.

data.define: Slang for cool clothes and a stylish look.

example.text: Nice jacket, you've got drip today.

misuse.text: Don't tell your boss 'nice drip' at work.
misuse.why: It's too slangy for formal settings.
